d:
The title track of 'Hamari Adhuri Kahani', is composed by Jeet Gannguli and sung by Arijit Singh. With lyrics by Rashmi Singh and Virag Mishra, the song talks about love and loss and features the beautiful Vidya Balan and charming Emraan Hashmi. 'Hamari Adhuri Kahani' is written by Mahesh Bhatt and is based on the love story of his parents. The film stars Vidya Balan, Emraan Hashmi and Rajkummar Rao.
Credits:

Movie - Hamari Adhuri Kahani
